title: Manage-sell-offer with offer ID 2^64-1 (beyond int64) must be refused
caps_note: offerID has been an int64 since the first protocol; the rule is in the XDR definitions and stellar-core's ManageOffer validation, not in a CAP.
why: ManageSellOfferOp.offerID is an int64 that stellar-core requires to be non-negative; a builder that accepts a value outside that range encodes another offer ID, so the operation edits or deletes a different offer, or is refused as malformed.

known_divergences.detail: ManageSellOffer packs the int64 offer ID modulo 2^64: 2^64-1 is encoded as -1.

notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/classic/api-offer-id-encoding.id-2-pow-64-minus-1.json. Origin: probe vector 2o2 (passed as a big integer here), in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). 2^64-1 does not fit an int64; a builder that wraps it encodes -1, which stellar-core rejects. Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
